# spaceman account

Harness accounts (credentials): list, show, add, update, delete and bind to spaces.

Aliases: `accounts`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman account create`](#spaceman-account-create) | Add an account; the secret comes from a file or standard input |
| [`spaceman account delete`](#spaceman-account-delete) | Delete an account no space uses |
| [`spaceman account get`](#spaceman-account-get) | Show an account |
| [`spaceman account kinds`](#spaceman-account-kinds) | Account kinds and the harness each serves |
| [`spaceman account list`](#spaceman-account-list) | Accounts (never their secrets) |
| [`spaceman account set-space`](#spaceman-account-set-space) | Replace the accounts a space's runs may use (at most one default per harness) |
| [`spaceman account space`](#spaceman-account-space) | Accounts a space's runs may use |
| [`spaceman account update`](#spaceman-account-update) | Edit an account; give --secret-file or --secret-stdin to rotate the secret |

## spaceman account create

Add an account; the secret comes from a file or standard input.

```sh
spaceman account create [flags]
```

API: `create-account` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman account create --name ci-claude --kind claude_oauth_token --secret-file ~/.config/claude-token
pass show claude | spaceman account create --name ci --kind anthropic_api_key --secret-stdin
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--idempotency-key` | string |  | Idempotency-Key to send (default: a fresh random key); reuse it to retry this create safely |
| `--kind` | string |  | claude_oauth_token, anthropic_api_key or openai_api_key |
| `--meta` | string, repeatable |  | metadata (key=value, repeatable) |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--secret-file` | string |  | the credential (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--secret-stdin` | bool |  | read --secret-file's value from standard input instead |

## spaceman account delete

Delete an account no space uses.

```sh
spaceman account delete <account> [flags]
```

API: `delete-account` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman account get

API: `get-account` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman account set-space

Replace the accounts a space's runs may use (at most one default per harness).

```sh
spaceman account set-space [flags]
```

API: `set-space-accounts` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman account set-space --space payments --account acc_01… --account acc_02… --default acc_01…
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--account` | string, repeatable |  | account ID the space may use (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `--default` | string, repeatable |  | account ID that is its harness's default (repeatable or comma-separated) |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman account space

## spaceman account update

Edit an account; give --secret-file or --secret-stdin to rotate the secret.

```sh
spaceman account update <account> [flags]
```

API: `get-account`, `update-account` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | enabled |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--kind` | string |  | claude_oauth_token, anthropic_api_key or openai_api_key |
| `--meta` | string, repeatable |  | metadata (key=value, repeatable) |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--secret-file` | string |  | the credential (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--secret-stdin` | bool |  | read --secret-file's value from standard input instead |
